reconstruction: For each target, compute Vietoris-Rips H1 Betti numbers from only the preceding draws. H1 removes triangle-filled graph cycles using GF(2) boundary-rank of d2. Hyperparameters selected using 2015-2018 references and 2019-2022 evaluation; final reference bank refit only through 2022 and frozen.

selection.criterion: pre-2023 only: full6 > hit5+ > meanBest > lower complexity

note: Topological H1 lane measuring genuine unfilled cycles rather than H0 connectivity or numeric gaps. Retrospective evidence never authorizes real money.
